title: File Locksmith Crush and Working Issue

actions.label: Request File Locksmith crash sequence

comment.body:
Thanks for attaching five FileLocksmithUI dump files; that is already useful evidence that this is a repeated native crash.

**Needed**
1. Please retest once on the latest stable or Preview build and give one numbered crash sequence, including the selected file or folder type and whether the crash happens before or after choosing the administrator option.
2. Immediately after that crash, please add a comment containing `/bugreport` so the generated ZIP captures the matching File Locksmith and runner logs.

This will distinguish the open handle-enumeration crash path in Issue 49789 from a separate administrator-retry or UI lifecycle failure.
